2608.27524.title: SETU: An Agentic Ecosystem for Multilingual, Persona-Aware Communication Coaching
2608.27524.paper_summary: Corporate training teams need scalable and explainable tools to improve workforce communication in multilingual settings. Existing systems often score text, audio, or video in isolation, or produce black-box outputs that are difficult to audit for coaching use. This paper presents SETU, an agentic ecosystem for corporate communication coaching aimed at recruiters, frontline sales professionals and training units who prepare for audience specific conversations. SETU is designed for two scoped scenarios: (i) recruiter-candidate eligibility-and-interest calls with persona context and (ii) sales pitches with target-audience adaptation; owing to limited evaluation resources, this paper reports results on scenario (ii) only. The ecosystem decomposes analysis into specialized video, audio-speech, text-relevance, scoring, notification and reporting agents coordinated through trust-aware orchestration. It generates modality-attributed coaching reports for formative training, with human reviewers retaining final judgment. The name SETU (bridge in several Indic languages) reflects the goal of bridging communication gaps across regional languages and audience expectations.
2608.27524.paper_summary_zh: 企業培訓團隊需要可擴展且可解釋的工具，以改善多語言環境中的員工溝通。現有系統通常孤立地對文本、音頻或視頻進行評分，或產生難以審核的黑箱輸出，無法用於輔導。本文介紹了SETU，一個針對招聘人員、一線銷售專業人士和準備針對特定受眾進行對話的培訓單位的企業溝通輔導代理生態系統。SETU 設計了兩個範疇的場景：（i）招聘人員與候選人之間的資格與興趣電話會議，並包含角色背景，以及（ii）針對目標受眾的銷售推介；由於評估資源有限，本文僅報告場景（ii）的結果。該生態系統將分析分解為專門的視頻、音頻語音、文本相關性、評分、通知和報告代理，並通過信任感知的協調進行協作。它為形成性培訓生成模式屬性輔導報告，並由人類審核者保留最終判斷。SETU（在幾種印度語言中意為橋樑）這個名稱反映了跨越地區語言和受眾期望的溝通橋樑的目標。
